structured.answer: Joining seems worth it because the employer adds 2,250 ₪ a month to my 750 ₪, but the money must stay 6 years or a big tax comes off (the page shows −64,761 ₪ at 5 years, 136,457 ₪ left in hand), and it is invested in something called "S&P500 / מדד", which sounds like shares — so I will ask my son before signing anything.

stuck.why: Red minus −64,761 ₪ with hatched red bar scared me; 136,457 left looked smaller than 45,000 + 135,000 and I didn't understand why
English letters S&P500, number (13245), 'מיטב השתלמות' — sounded like stock market, I skipped
My salary is 30,000; unclear what the limit means for me
Tired, too much text; stopped here
